compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug 3781-9cec-5cf5-46be stopped scenario_4 of infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh claiming a Verified rerun it only recorded. Proving the rerun needs a live run.

## Approach
In a session with admin and feature-driver rights, observe whether Verified is absent right after the re-merge push and returns to the maximum once CI reruns; if the behaviour is stable, add that assertion to scenario_4 with a bounded poll, and extend the stubbed test.

## Testing
A live run of feature-branch-e2e.sh with SCENARIOS=4, output recorded on this task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A live scenario 4 run records Verified absent after the re-merge push and back at the maximum after CI (checked: run output recorded in a ticket comment).
compiled_state.title: Make e2e scenario 4 prove a Verified rerun against live Gerrit
